| `onExtensionCall(bytes)` | Extension hatch receiving hook (D17 Option A), forwarded from MidwayBuyer.extensionCall. V1 ships no extension verbs: this reverts before any state read, so no funds path exists through it. A future engine version decodes `data` against its own versioned selector table and authorizes using the original external caller, which MidwayBuyer appends as a trailing 20 bytes of calldata after the abi-encoded call. Dead code at launch; flagged for the external audit. |
| `onExtensionCallGlobal(bytes)` | Non-request-scoped counterpart of `onExtensionCall`, forwarded from MidwayBuyer.extensionCallGlobal. Same launch behavior: unconditional revert before any state read. |

### View

| Function | Notice |
| --- | --- |
| `accruedRewardMinimumOutput(uint256)` | Minimum token output for an accrued-reward claim on `midwayRequestId`: the request's unspent FWARewards allowance and the conversion-floor policy on it. `valid` is false when the allowance is zero or no effective floor exists; `claimAccruedRewards` reverts in either case. |
| `acquisitionReadiness()` | Acquire-pacing signals read from FWA, for a keeper to gate a new acquisition rather than firing one into FWA's VRF backpressure. FWA reverts `InsufficientVrfCoverage` when its subscription cannot underwrite another callback while `unfulfilledVrf` requests are outstanding; a keeper seeing a nonzero `unfulfilledVrf` should call `processAcquisitions` and wait for fulfillment before requesting. `priced` is false when the pool cannot currently quote (also unacquirable), and `activeListings` is zero when nothing is selectable. A pure read: it never predicts coverage exactly (that lives in FWA's VRF service), it surfaces the signals the caller paces on. |
